scope: Corollary 2.13 (Pointwise axis prediction) of the manuscript “Elliptic capacity propagation and Fourier restriction to the sphere” (preprints/Elliptic-capacity-propagation-and-Fourier-restriction-to-the-sphere-September-24-2026/Elliptic-capacity-propagation-and-Fourier-restriction-to-the-sphere-September-24-2026.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 077 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 669efdbef9150144), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 24. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: In the families of Lemma 2.12, two retained particles with the same P = (U, V ) and the same time prefix at a local epoch have reference axes agreeing to that epoch’s aspect precision, up to a factor Mo(δ). In a bounded-slope sector, the number of possible reference-slope bins at depth d0 + δλv, given the base label and the time prefix at y0 + δv, is at most Mo(δ).
